title: Forge SMP
description: Join a thriving survival SMP built around community, adventure, and long-term progression. Establish your base, build an economy, participate in exciting events, and forge your own story alongside other players in a world that rewards creativity.
body: Join a thriving survival SMP built around community, adventure, and long-term progression. Establish your base, build an economy, participate in exciting events, and forge your own story alongside other players in a world that rewards creativity, exploration, and dedication.
